newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firm after 300,000 tonnes sails west.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firm after 300,000 tonnes sails west.

text.p: NWE gasoline was firm on Wednesday after an estimated 300,000 tonnes of September-loading material was sold transatlantic in the past week, traders said.
A 30,000 tonne cargo was sold this or last week out of the Mediterranean for the U.S., a trader said, in addition to the 270,000 tonnes reported earlier in the day.

A 7,000 tonne Eurograde piece was traded at fob high +$1, fob Fos. Good demand was seen for 98 RON barrels into Lavera, where MTBE production has been cut back. Offers were seen out of NWE - one was seen at Eurograde barge quotes +$25 fip Lavera.
